name: Harut Flower Traitaun
original_name: ハールート・フラワウル・トライタウナ
source:
He is the chief guardian of the city of Valusia and a reformer who, two years ago, decided to liberate the "Great Canopy" that had covered the city's sky for 1,000 years.

He's the protagonist of the seventh chapter.
